gate_semantics.general: A gate decision is an evidence-bound engineering, data and scientific review recorded with input hashes; setting accepted=true without those checks is invalid.

required_checks: real source-map and receipt identities match the registered V1 ML seed-17 smoke attempt
actual M entry position is reported and qualified without fallback or misplacement
actual FCD traverses the registered feeder and common domains; the route alone is insufficient

TLS, link and detector definitions are loaded and the complete registered time endpoints are present; legitimate incomplete or non-traversal states remain explicit and are handled by the registered censoring and qualification rules
all 14 required runtime XML roles are non-empty, well-formed, have the registered root and contain required records

runtime outputs and a smoke-specific technical measurement receipt are archived and hash-bound; this receipt must not use the scientific-analysis entry point that rejects smoke and must not enter the 352 main or 14 sensitivity denominators
no result from the smoke is used as Q2-Q4 scientific evidence
smoke_acceptance_gate.on_pass: run the seed-17 validation pair sequentially
smoke_acceptance_gate.on_technical_failure: a registered retry may consume the one shared global retry only when the failure satisfies the pre-registered technical-failure rule
smoke_acceptance_gate.on_evidence_or_qualification_failure: stop; classify blocked_by_evidence_error or not_resolved as registered; do not release validation

required_checks: both attempts are qualified, identity-bound and form the registered same-seed ML/C pair
the data analyst independently rebuilds the registered core metrics, travel-time interval bounds and censoring states, shared support blocks and boundary states from both real source XML archives
the data analyst independently recomputes the registered primary rule, Q1-Q4 rules, R and shared R/U evidence rules
the data analyst independently recomputes all seven registered sensitivity rules with fixed denominators
the scientific reviewer reviews the independent recomputation before the gate is signed
negative, unpaired, infinite-bound and missing-evidence states are preserved
first_matched_unit_acceptance_gate.on_all_required_seed17_checks_pass: run the seed-23 validation pair sequentially
first_matched_unit_acceptance_gate.on_any_complete_qualified_scientific_che: classify not_resolved and stop; do not start seed 23 because the registered all-seed success rule can no longer pass
first_matched_unit_acceptance_gate.on_technical_failure: a registered same-parameter retry may consume the one shared global retry; otherwise stop

full_matrix_analysis.required_scope: both qualified matched seed pairs and every registered primary and sensitivity rule
full_matrix_analysis.pass_result: eligible for SG6-R obstacle-resolution review; not itself SG6-R approval
full_matrix_analysis.fail_result: not_resolved or blocked_by_evidence_error; formal design remains locked

budget_and_execution_constraints.watchdog_note: The watchdog polls and terminates the process after the registered limit; it is not an operating-system hard resource quota.
budget_and_execution_constraints.counting_rule: Every SUMO process start counts, including failed or timed-out starts. The retry budget is shared by the whole block.

change_control: Changing an input, threshold, seed, attempt mapping, executable, budget, stop rule or bound hash invalidates this approval overlay and requires a revised package and approval.
